description: Structured Home Field image-generation queue for agent/factory runs. Each item is a durable, machine-readable contract; prompt text and workflow docs remain the detailed human source.

items.displayTitle: Thalla Home Field chibi Stage 1 proof
items.minimalLauncherPrompt: In /Users/microwavedev/workspace/microwave-hub/mushroom-master, run `npm run game:home-field:generation-queue -- --id=thalla-stage1-chibi-proof` and use the printed queue results to generate what is needed.

promptPolicy.action: Do not issue another production launcher for the same supplied local state-sheet source hash. Rollout codex-019f1f94-ed13-7701-85a2-62a97f7431e7 proved the queue-owned sourcePath exists and stages, but its derived reference proxy failed the hard palette audit.
promptPolicy.blockedPromptAction: Use this queue output as a blocker report. Continue only after replacing generationContract.stateSheet.localSourceMode.sourcePath with a new authored complete 8x4 local state-sheet PNG outside docs/reference. A palette-cleanup/repair method is secondary and must be explicit evidence-backed candidate repair, not the preferred production path; do not adopt any source or candidate hash listed under sourceGateRecovery.exhaustedRepairSources.
promptPolicy.blockedShortResponse: Blocked: the current supplied local source hash failed the reference palette audit; provide a new authored paletted 8x4 source, or an explicit evidence-backed repair experiment, before another production run.

sourceGateRecovery.summary: When the user asks for another production-ready run while this sourceGate is blocked, the next pasted prompt must stay queue-only but must identify the printed queue SourceGate recovery production attempt results as the instructions to execute.
sourceGateRecovery.copyablePrompt: In /Users/microwavedev/workspace/microwave-hub/mushroom-master, run `npm run game:home-field:generation-queue -- --id=thalla-stage1-chibi-proof` and use the printed queue SourceGate recovery production attempt results to generate what is needed.
requiredActions: Treat this SourceGate recovery production attempt section as the source of truth; do not inline these method-change details into the copyable user prompt.
Confirm the existing sourceGate blocker and blocked source hash before creating or adopting a replacement source.

Prefer producing or accepting a genuinely new authored complete 8x4 local state-sheet source outside docs/reference; use palette-cleanup/repair only as a secondary explicit method when no source-generation surface is available or when intentionally running a diagnostic/candidate-repair experiment.

Do not adopt any exhausted repair source or candidate hash listed below; if only exhausted repair sources exist, stop and report missing fresh authored-source capability instead of rerunning gates or committing the same verdict.

The next source must read as a youthful little-girl mushroom-elf chibi like the liked Thalla reference, with rounded cheeks, a sweet simple face, compact but visible oval/almond doll eyes, tiny childlike body, and soft hand-drawn field-sprite charm; do not accept an old monk, beige mascot pawn, elderly gnome, faceless mushroom token, skull-mask face, hollow pin-dot eyes, or blank mask read.

The next source and split frames must be character-only: do not accept detached motion/action lines, squiggle marks, speed lines, text marks, punctuation-like accents, stray specks, or other non-character components baked outside the main sprite body.

Reject cute-but-generic anime style explicitly: no large glossy/white anime eyes, no visible human hair, bangs, or wig locks under the mushroom cap in any direction, no brooch, medallion, clasp, or jewelry-like chest detail, and no polished high-res character-turnaround normalized down as if style-approved.

If a raw imagegen sheet ignores the exact source-scale request and returns an oversized polished character sheet, treat normalization as technical processing only; fail the visual gate if the normalized source still carries generic anime, hair/wig, glossy-eye, or jewelry drift.

Keep the generation prompt style-led before it is constraint-led: carry forward the old liked prompt language "cute dark storybook", "simple BJD-inspired chibi doll face", "smooth BJD-like face planes", and "rounded cheeks"; use the palette limit as a production constraint, not as the main style identity.

Do not record a Thalla recovery as needs_review merely because it is better than older rejected lineages; compare against the positive references as an absolute target, and record needs_regen if the best claim is only "better than old-monk/skull-mask/anime failures".

If palette cleanup, quantization, resize, or chroma repair is used, compare the raw generated source, repaired source, final candidate, and the two positive references before recording a verdict; reject the repair as needs_regen if it flattens the old-reference softness, doll-face warmth, rounded cheeks, or cute little-girl charm even when palette audits pass.

Do not flip existing visual fail checks to pass or upgrade needs_regen to needs_review from mechanical validators, passing palette/alpha/readability scripts, or self-authored reason text; only clear them after a fresh positive-reference visual comparison that survives all user-rejected lineage checks.

If a repair method reuses the blocked art lineage, declare that lineage in the repair manifest and keep the final verdict as an intentional blocker unless the visual gate clears the preserved source defects; passing palette/count scripts alone is not production-ready.

Do not stop only because no replacement source already exists; if the current tool surface cannot create or repair a source, report that missing capability explicitly instead of treating the old blocker as completion.
Use `--source=<new-source-png>` for preflight, archive, and stage; do not use the blocked queue source hash.
Run reference proxy, state-sheet, frame, candidate, evidence, preview, and verdict gates only after the new source passes preflight/archive/stage.
Keep app-facing PNGs untouched until explicit approval.

exhaustedRepairSources.reason: Do not rerun this exhausted repair source as another production attempt: it preserves the purple-pink edge/status ornament drift and was recorded as needs_regen, not production-ready.

Do not rerun this candidate-only SourceGate recovery source: the rollout recorded needs_review, then the user rejected the style because it reads too much like an old mushroom monk/mascot pawn and not enough like the youthful little-girl chibi in the liked Thalla reference.

Do not rerun this imagegen SourceGate recovery source: the rollout recorded needs_review, then the user rejected the new images because the older cute little-girl references were much better. The sheet has a skull-mask/hollow pin-dot face and loses the liked reference's soft doll face, visible oval eyes, rounded cheeks, and cute little-girl expression.

Do not rerun this charm-improved SourceGate recovery source unchanged: it moved closer to the old liked little-girl reference, but black detached motion/squiggle marks were baked into a front idle frame. The sheet is not character-only and is not production-ready.

Do not rerun this cute-but-user-rejected anime recovery source as another production attempt: raw 1774x887 source f3912ce84df9c1c732d4c85b2adbff8c6a429bf186332977389dc443134837a1 was normalized and palette-cleaned into the staged source, but it reads as a polished generic anime chibi turnaround with large glossy/white eyes, visible hair/bangs or wig fringe under the mushroom cap, and brooch/medallion-like status ornament. It is not production-ready and misses the old liked soft little-girl field-sprite reference.

Do not rerun this attempt3 SourceGate recovery source: the rollout recorded needs_review after mechanical validators passed, but the user called it a real style regression. It is not enough that the repaired source looks better than older old-monk/skull-mask/anime failures; the final sheet still misses the old liked soft little-girl reference and collapses into a tiny uniform mascot/token read after normalization and palette repair. It is not production-ready, and visual fail checks must not be flipped to pass from validator output or self-authored needs_review prose.

successCriteria: A new source path and sha256 are reported.
The new source and candidate sha256 values must not match the blocked source hash or any exhausted repair source/candidate hash.

The composed preview and source sheet read as a youthful little-girl Thalla chibi like docs/reference/home-field/chibi-thalla-liked-2026-06-23.png and docs/reference/home-field/chibi-thalla-previous-best-2026-06-26-state-sheet.png, with the old reference's soft doll face, visible oval/almond eyes, rounded cheeks, and cute expression; not an old monk, beige mascot pawn, elderly gnome, faceless mushroom token, skull-mask face, or hollow pin-dot-eye mask.
The candidate is not merely an improvement over older rejected lineages; it must be as soft, charming, and little-girl readable as the positive references, or it remains needs_regen.

The source sheet, split frames, and candidate remain character-only: no detached motion/action/squiggle/speed-line marks, text marks, punctuation-like accents, stray specks, baked shadows, or background/floor components outside the sprite body.

The raw generated source, repaired source, and candidate are not a generic anime/doll turnaround: eyes stay compact dark doll ovals with minimal/no white sclera, the cap has no visible hair/wig fringe underneath, the chest has no brooch/medallion/clasp, and an oversized polished sheet is not accepted merely because it can be normalized to 512x256.

Any repaired/quantized source preserves the raw imagegen sheet's soft/charming face and improves toward the old liked reference; palette repair must not turn the sprite into a flat toy, hard icon, or generic mascot.

Any prior needs_regen verdict or fail visual check stays failed unless fresh visual review proves an absolute positive-reference match; mechanical validators alone cannot upgrade the verdict or review checks.
Reference proxy, staged state sheet, and candidate palette audits pass the fewer-than-20 visible design color gate.
Split frames, candidate validation, evidence, preview, and verdict complete.

If the run used repair instead of a new authored source, the final response labels it as a repair experiment and does not claim production-ready unless visual review clears the original source defects.
The final response clearly distinguishes production-ready candidate output from an intentional blocker.

agentInstructions: Treat the existing Thalla Home Field chibi Stage 1 source hash as blocked; do not run the default production path against that hash.
Follow app/shared/home-field/RUN_CHIBI_PROOF_PROMPT.md exactly.

Prefer a genuinely new authored complete 8x4 source for another production-ready attempt. Palette-cleanup/repair is secondary evidence-backed candidate repair, not a production-ready shortcut.

Do not rerun the cute-but-user-rejected anime recovery source .agent/home-field-workspace/supplied/thalla_sourcegate_recovery_fresh_2026-07-02_bjd_littlegirl_512x256_quant20_rgba.states.source.png, source sha256 1f97d423792a5396a4b325d7c4d4f08d7e33d7b254d1ea57d39fe75133af8f70, or candidate sha256 7bcd69287d4662b691f487262837899f06da83eb4530c230bff5195f21f6e26b as another production-ready attempt because it is a style regression: polished generic anime/chibi turnaround, large glossy/white eyes, visible hair/bangs or wig fringe under the cap, and brooch/medallion ornament instead of the old liked soft little-girl field-sprite reference.

Style target for the next authored source: the liked Thalla reference and previous-best state sheet should drive the face/body read. Thalla must look like a youthful little-girl mushroom-elf chibi with rounded cheeks, compact but visible oval/almond doll eyes, tiny planted body, and soft hand-drawn charm; reject old monk, beige mascot pawn, elderly gnome, faceless mushroom-token, skull-mask face, hollow pin-dot eyes, blank mask face, or generic robed elder reads even if mechanical validators pass.

Before recording a verdict, inspect the raw generated source, staged/repaired source, split raw frames, and candidate for detached motion/action lines, squiggle marks, speed lines, text marks, punctuation-like accents, or stray specks; any such non-character marks are needs_regen even if palette, alpha, animation, and readability validators pass.

For the next charm-improvement run, treat the 2026-07-02 needs_review candidate from rollout codex-019f2495-31ad-7033-9436-aee13df5de65 (source sha256 115f77467df49e07f8b2a7b4e2c2afa1222d59310e67a5dfc093d82aa7dc545d, candidate sha256 6ae5e6f886c9e99f7a1ea6700eb035c87dffd479222cb55f713e019d0182d06a) as a baseline to beat, not as approval; do not simply restage or re-record it as the requested improvement.

During final visual review, open/view the liked 2026-06-23 reference, previous-best 2026-06-26 sheet, raw generated source before repair, repaired source, final candidate, and composed previews; the verdict reason must say whether charm survived palette repair.

Do not use relative comparison to older rejected lineages as approval. If the verdict reason can only claim the candidate is better than old-monk/skull-mask/anime failures, but not as soft and charming as the positive little-girl references, record needs_regen.

Do not flip fail visual checks to pass or upgrade needs_regen to needs_review from mechanical validators, palette/alpha/readability passes, or a self-authored needs_review reason. Clear those fields only after fresh positive-reference visual comparison.

During final visual review, record needs_regen if the source or candidate is merely cute generic anime/chibi, has large glossy white eyes, visible hair/bangs/wig fringe under the mushroom cap, or brooch/medallion/clasp ornament, even if palette, alpha, animation, readability, and chibi-quality validators pass.

If the only available replacement is an exhausted repair source, stop and report missing fresh authored-source capability instead of rerunning the same gates or committing the same needs_regen verdict again.
Do not call a clean sourceGate block a healthy production-ready image run; production-ready PNGs were not produced unless a new candidate passes every listed gate.

Do not rerun preflight/archive/stage for the current generationContract.stateSheet.localSourceMode.sourcePath (.agent/home-field-workspace/supplied/thalla_tetro_cleaned_2026-06-30.states.source.png) because sourceGate records that this exact source hash failed the reference palette audit.
If the user supplies a new complete 8x4 local state-sheet source, update generationContract.stateSheet.localSourceMode.sourcePath and the printed --source commands before issuing a launcher.

If a palette-cleanup or repair method is intentionally adopted, add it as an explicit active method with evidence, not as hidden fallback behavior; if it preserves blocked-source visual defects, record needs_regen rather than production-ready.

Treat styleReferences as visual review references only; reference imagegen is skipped, and agents must not attach styleReferences to imagegen or run reference imagegen for this blocked local-source item.
Do not use built-in imagegen, paid API fallback, or --show-fallbacks unless planning a future method change with explicit user approval.
Report the blocked source path/hash, failed reference proxy hash, failed palette audit counts, and the requirement for a new authored source or explicitly documented secondary repair method.
Do not overwrite app-facing PNGs during candidate proof; write only to .agent/home-field-workspace/candidates/chibi-active-roster/latest until approved.

commands.recordVerdict: printf '%s\n' '<visual-critic reason>' | npm run game:home-field:record-chibi-verdict -- thalla --verdict=needs_regen --reason-stdin

referenceSheet.method: For active supplied local-source mode, stage-chibi-local-source derives a deterministic non-production reference proxy from the supplied state sheet; reference imagegen is skipped. Inactive imagegen/API methods are printed only with --show-fallbacks.
referenceSheet.paletteBudget: 12-18 artist-visible colors; fewer than 20 total design colors excluding transparency and #ff00ff
referenceSheet.mustShow: tiny down, up, left, and right source-sprite views inside invisible 96x96 boxes with at least 70% empty #ff00ff space
referenceSheet.styleReferencesUsage: styleReferences are visual review references only in active supplied local-source mode.

stateSheet.method: one supplied complete 8x4 local state-sheet source staged through game:home-field:stage-chibi-local-source
stateSheet.layout: 8 columns x 4 rows; rows down, up, left, right; 2 idle plus 6 walk frames per row
stateSheet.motionRule: idle bob and walk poses must exist in the grouped sheet itself; do not synthesize motion after split; do not draw detached motion/action/squiggle/speed-line marks outside the character body

stopRules: Stop if preflight with the queue-owned --source path fails.
Stop if archive-stale-chibi-proof with the same --source path fails.
Stop if stage-chibi-local-source with the same --source path fails; do not fall back to imagegen or stale .agent files.
Stop if the derived reference proxy or staged state sheet fails verifier, palette audit, or visual gate.
Stop if split, frame verification, candidate production, candidate validation, evidence, preview, or verdict recording fails.

Stop if any source, split frame, or candidate frame contains detached non-character motion/action/squiggle/speed-line marks, text marks, punctuation-like accents, stray specks, baked shadows, or background/floor components.

Stop if the source or candidate reads as a merely cute generic anime/doll turnaround, has large glossy/white eyes, visible hair/bangs/wig fringe under the cap, brooch/medallion/clasp ornament, or an oversized polished character-sheet look normalized down without style approval.
Stop if the only positive claim is relative improvement over older rejected lineages rather than an absolute match to the liked soft little-girl Thalla references.
Do not run reference imagegen, built-in imagegen, or paid API fallback in the default local-source run; use --show-fallbacks only to inspect inactive methods for a future method change.
Do not overwrite app-facing PNGs during candidate proof.
finalResponseMustReport: archive result and staged local-source provenance manifest
statement that reference imagegen was skipped and a deterministic reference proxy was derived
reference proxy, staged state-sheet, and candidate palette audit verdicts
split frame verification, candidate validation, evidence, preview, and verdict status
that no app-facing PNG was overwritten

sourceGate.action: Do not rerun this exact supplied source hash as a production-ready path. Replace it with a new authored paletted complete 8x4 local source outside docs/reference. Use a dedicated palette-cleanup/repair method only as secondary evidence-backed candidate repair with manifest evidence and visual gates.

styleReferences.role: primary positive compact grouped-sheet proportions and charm; fix palette bloat, ornament, and sticker softness
styleReferences.usage: visual style reference for local-source review; not an active imagegen input in supplied local-source mode

styleReferences.role: primary positive youthful little-girl Thalla face, cap, robe, compact oval/almond doll eyes, rounded-cheek appeal, and soft hand-drawn charm; simplify heavily for the 64px field sprite
styleReferences.usage: visual style reference for local-source review; not an active imagegen input in supplied local-source mode

styleReferences.role: target scale, outline weight, and scene-scale simplicity only; do not copy symbols, costumes, or composition
styleReferences.usage: visual style reference for local-source review; not an active imagegen input in supplied local-source mode

inactiveMethods.label: Built-in imagegen same-context reference staging
inactiveMethods.reason: Moved out of the default local-source run path because rollout codex-019f1eb1-1027-7752-95cf-d4f37cb0041c exhausted it for unchanged Thalla proof runs.

builtInImagegen.referenceStaging: Load all 3 referenceInputs PNGs with view_image as the current imagegen skill's same-context input-staging step before imagegen.
builtInImagegen.generationCall: Call built-in image_gen in that same context and explicitly name the visible referenceInputs images as references.
builtInImagegen.afterRender: Save each generated PNG directly to the required output path, or claim a discoverable built-in output with npm run game:home-field:claim-imagegen-output -- --since=<render-start-iso> --dest=<documented-path> --verify=<reference|state-sheet>.
builtInImagegen.notEnough: Passive viewing, listing paths, or mentioning reference paths in prompt text is not enough unless the following same-context built-in image_gen call uses those visible images as references.

methodGate.reason: The queue-backed built-in path was tried with same-context view_image staging, a same-context built-in image_gen reference call, and save/claim handoff. It still failed the reference verifier with 1448x1086 oversized turnaround figures and failed palette audit with 91 significant exact colors, so this built-in method is exhausted for unchanged Thalla proof runs.
methodGate.allowedPath: Do not run the built-in same-context staging path again. Continue only with a different reference-capable generation/editing method, supplied local proof source PNGs outside docs/reference, or explicit user-approved fallback.
methodGate.stopIf: Stop before archive/imagegen if no different method/source-input path is available; the exhausted built-in staging path must not be retried.

inactiveMethods.label: Paid API reference fallback
inactiveMethods.reason: Only for an explicit future method change when built-in/imagegen is unavailable; not part of the current supplied local-source run.

blockedRunEvidence.reason: The agent used mushroom-master/.env for --env-file; preflight correctly failed because the required imagegen fallback environment was missing. Future API fallback runners must receive an explicit env file path with OPENAI_IMAGEGEN_API_KEY and HOME_FIELD_IMAGEGEN_SKILL_UNAVAILABLE=1 instead of guessing. Plain OPENAI_API_KEY must not count.
